Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Samantha,I hope you are doing well. My name is Sara from Avicenna. We've received your request for a meeting. Thank you for your interest in our product and for sharing information about your project with us. We'd be happy to help you with your study.We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. We’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.You can certainly implement your ESM intervention study in Avicenna and monitor the compliance rate of participants. This will allow you to generate reports based on their performance. More information about compliance monitoring in Avicenna is available here.Please note that we offer the trial version for test purposes only. Indeed we want to give a chance to researchers to make sure our tool is the right fit for their projects. We don't have any restrictions with regard to the features in the trial version, except the fact that we periodically remove the data to make sure we provide a better service to the licensed studies. Therefore, a license is required if you wish to use Avicenna in a field deployment with actual participants.Generally, our pricing depends on three factors: The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well) The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study) The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll If you could share more details about your research, we'd be better equipped to help you.On another note, I wanted to mention that we genuinely care about the research work and if budget is a concern, we would be more than happy to discuss it further.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts.If you’d like, we can arrange a brief meeting to demo our product and discuss your project. Our calendar is shared here, and we have a flexible schedule from October 23rd onward.Best,Sara--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com--------

"Vos, Samantha" <samantha.vos@ou.nl>:
Hi Sara, Thank you for reaching out. I would like to know more about pricing if possible. I would like to collect ESM data from maximum 300 respondents, with each respondent participating for 28 days. I am especially interested to know if it is possible to create personalized reports of each participants responses and personalized feedback based on responses. I must say that I do have a very limited budget, but provided Avicenna can support these two features I would prefer to use it over another platform. Looking forward to your response, Samantha Samantha Vos | PhD candidate Department Conditions for Lifelong Learning Faculty of Educational Sciences Open University
----

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Tuesday, October 8, 2024 8:44 PM To: Vos, Samantha <samantha.vos@ou.nl> Subject: Welcome to Avicenna Dear Samantha, I hope you are doing well. My name is Sara from Avicenna. We've received your request for a meeting. Thank you for your interest in our product and for sharing information about your project with us. We'd be happy to help you with your study. We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. We’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product. You can certainly implement your ESM intervention study in Avicenna and monitor the compliance rate of participants. This will allow you to generate reports based on their performance. More information about compliance monitoring in Avicenna is available here. Please note that we offer the trial version for test purposes only. Indeed we want to give a chance to researchers to make sure our tool is the right fit for their projects. We don't have any restrictions with regard to the features in the trial version, except the fact that we periodically remove the data to make sure we provide a better service to the licensed studies. Therefore, a license is required if you wish to use Avicenna in a field deployment with actual participants. Generally, our pricing depends on three factors: The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well) The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study) The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll If you could share more details about your research, we'd be better equipped to help you. On another note, I wanted to mention that we genuinely care about the research work and if budget is a concern, we would be more than happy to discuss it further. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts. If you’d like, we can arrange a brief meeting to demo our product and discuss your project. Our calendar is shared here, and we have a flexible schedule from October 23rd onward. Best, Sara -- Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data) 4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com --------

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Samantha,I hope you’re having a great weekend. I apologize for my delayed response.Thank you for providing information about your study. I would be more than happy to help you with your questions.Based on your description, the total licensing cost to collect survey responses (ESM data) from up to 300 participants for 28 days will be CAD 2,127.90 (~ 1,413.89€). However, I understand your situation and am pleased to offer you a 30% discount, bringing the total to CAD 1,489.53 (~ 989.72€). I hope this helps with your project budget. Please let me know if this works for you, and I’ll provide more details about the next steps. In general, our patient-centric research tool makes it easy to collect different types of data from participants, process and visualize it, and even trigger customized interventions, all in one place. For instance, interventions can be triggered based on previously collected survey data to give participants personalized feedback. Using Triggering Logics and Criteria, you can tailor the behavior of your surveys. You can also access and review the survey responses right from your researcher dashboard. For detailed instructions, please refer to this link. Moreover, our researcher dashboard includes smart filters, enabling you to filter and export survey responses. You can customize the available columns in the exported file using the "Filter" option on the "Activity Responses" page. For example, you can create unique exports for each participant and import the data into any software you prefer to generate personalized reports. More information on data filtering can be found here. Additionally, please feel free to find more about data analysis and data visualization in Avicenna here. Using Kibana, you can create different graphs and charts from your data. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out. Looking forward to working with you. Best, Sara --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Wednesday, October 9, 2024 at 12:24:40 PM,
